optimizedDescription.value: IndexCodeGraph orchestrates two-pass extraction, incremental hashing, spec metadata indexing, and bulk persistence into GraphStore.

optimizedContext.value:
# Indexer

## Rules

- `IndexCodeGraph`: primary write path. Pipeline: discover → diff → extract → spec indexing → store → clean → persist `lastIndexedRef`.
- Spec data via `SpecRepository` (`list`, `artifact`, `readPersistedImplementation`) + `GetSpecMetadata` (`title`, `description`, `metadataFingerprint`). No raw sidecar parsing; no raw metadata snapshot when materialized projection available.
- Incremental diff: content hash per file vs `GraphStore`; fingerprint = effective `@specd/code-graph` package version + canonical hash of resolved workspaces.
- Fingerprint match → process New/Changed/Deleted only; hash-equal files skipped (no parse, no I/O beyond hash). Deletion scoped to indexed workspaces (`--workspace <name>` safe).
- Fingerprint mismatch → destructive full rebuild via `recreate()`; visible reason (`fullRebuildReason`, `fullRebuild`); backend unable to recreate in place MAY fail fast. Force re-index: recreation path before `execute()`.
- Changed files removed pre-bulk-load: CSV `COPY FROM` insert-only, cannot upsert.
- Fingerprint inputs: `graph.includePaths`, `graph.excludePaths`, per-workspace `allowedPaths`, `excludePaths`, `respectGitignore`, synthetic exclusions from `specsPath` roots.
- Discovery: workspace roots (prefix `{workspaceName}:`) + project-global (`root:` prefix; only outside every workspace `codeRoot`). Adapter files → `FileNode`; textual no-adapter → `DocumentNode`. `specsPath` roots synthetically excluded; specs indexed only via spec phase.
- Decode: BOM `utf-8`/`utf-16le`/`utf-16be` → `utf-8` → `utf-16le`/`utf-16be` (null-byte layout) → `windows-1252` (no NUL) → else skip.
- `discoverFiles`: `respectGitignore` (default true, absolute priority), `excludePaths` (defaults `.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`), `vcsRoot` (from `VcsAdapter.rootDir()`; explicit `null` when none; no self-probing).
- Binary filter before decoding: `.gif`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.pdf`, `.sql`, `.zip`, `.tiff`, `.pack` etc.
- Memory: shared `IndexSession` lookups; compact per-file facts; no AST/parse-tree retention across run; Pass 1 allocation transient only.
- Passes:
  1. Pass 1 (per workspace, chunks): read, adapter `FileAnalysis`, register; emit `DEFINES`/`EXPORTS`.
  2. Pass 2 (all workspaces): resolve `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` from session facts; no store queries.
  3. Specs: `repo.count()` upfront; `repo.list()`; `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })`; compare `metadataFingerprint`; load `title`/`description` (prefer `optimizedDescription`); `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL` via `readPersistedImplementation()`; `DEPENDS_ON` via `readPersistedDependsOn()`.
  4. Commit: `GraphStore.bulkLoad()` once; `GraphStore.rebuildFtsIndexes()`.
- `IndexSession`: run-scoped in-memory — files + numeric IDs, analyses, symbols (file/name/qualified), docs, specs, deterministic facts, deduped relations; common adapter API; never changes store schema/IDs/relation semantics.
- Scoped binding env: shared code-graph builder; deterministic lookup for scopes, shadowing, binding kinds, receivers (`this`, `self`, `cls`, `parent`, `super`), call candidates; deterministic targets only; drop self-relations (source id === target id); ambiguous/unresolved → no persisted relations; no language-specific rules in `IndexCodeGraph`.
- Chunking: `IndexOptions.chunkBytes` (default 20 MB); sequential chunks for GC. Spill optional: temp dir from project config, run-scoped, cleaned after success.
- Progress: `onProgress(percent, phase)`; 0-5 discovery/hash, 5-7 diff/cleanup, 7-50 Pass 1, 50-80 Pass 2, 80-83 specs, 83-95 bulk load, 100 done; detail strings; fire immediately at phase end.
- Debug-level timing logs per phase (File Discovery, Pass 1, Pass 2, Spec Indexing, Bulk Load).
- Package map `packageName → workspaceName` via `adapter.getPackageIdentity(codeRoot)` before Pass 2; first non-`undefined` wins; monorepo + multirepo; non-relative specifiers resolved via session.
- Error isolation: per-file errors recorded `{ filePath, message }`, run continues; only infrastructure errors abort.
- `IndexResult`: `filesDiscovered`, `filesIndexed`, `filesRemoved`, `filesSkipped`, `specsDiscovered`, `specsIndexed`, `errors`, `duration`, per-workspace `workspaces`, `vcsRef`, `graphFingerprint`, `fullRebuild`, `fullRebuildReason`.
- Specs phase after source indexing; no CLI pre-extraction.
- Reference facts: persist coverage outcome for every target (content hash, excluded, unsupported capability, parse-failed, partial); absence-decision errors not transient-only; `COVERS_SYMBOL` → logical-symbol identity; no guessed relations; retain indexed content per file; construct + declared-name ranges preserved end-to-end; lookup indexes built once per session; bounded batch writes.
- Incompatible derivation/schema → destructive full rebuild via provider-owned recreation; rotate storage generation; report reason; read paths never repair silently.
- Observation capture: atomic replace indexed-input observations (`stale: false`), VCS base-ref/diff evidence; clear latches only on commit; failures never clear; prune removed/obsolete in same generation.
- Incremental: mtime/size stamps fast path; content hash authoritative; equal stamps reuse hash; semantic refresh re-extracts new/changed + transitive importer/relation/hierarchy closure; addition-only fallback for newly added files (not classified content-indexed); unaffected files keep nodes without extraction; destructive replacement only for force/incompatible/empty; affected-route work queues; bounded chunks, single commit, at most one search rebuild; unchanged generation preserves snapshot, updates metadata/freshness only; coverage hashes diff non-text targets; full == incremental equivalence; progress counts per relation kind; persistence timing includes cleanup/staged/observation/relation/non-search commit; search timing zero when not requested.

## Constraints

- `GraphStore` open before use; indexer does not manage store lifecycle.
- Forward-slash workspace-relative paths.
- `excludePaths` replaces built-in defaults entirely (no merge): `node_modules/`, `.git/`, `.specd/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `.next/`, `.nuxt/`.
- `respectGitignore: true` → `.gitignore` absolute priority.
- Pass 1 completes for ALL workspaces before Pass 2 (never interleaved per file or workspace).
- Per-file errors collected, not thrown; only infrastructure errors abort.
- Spec indexing via workspace `specs()` callback only — no filesystem fallback.
- Binding env: in-memory pass facts only; no store queries during analysis.
- `IndexCodeGraph`: no language-specific binding/call-resolution rules.
- Unresolved/ambiguous binding facts → no persisted relations.
- Self-relations (source id === target id) never persisted.
